_doc: How JLCPCB's own model of a part sits against our footprint, per LCSC part. JLCPCB places each part by its model, which is drawn about an origin and at an orientation of its own; the CPL's Mid X/Y and Rotation are measured from those, not from KiCad's footprint (easy-stick 14.18). The table is what JLCPCB's placement preview showed (issue #6 on 2026-11-11, issue #8 on 2026-11-13). An entry has one or both of two fields. add: degrees, counter-clockwise (90, 180 or 270), that make_outputs.py adds to the footprint's KiCad orientation to get the CPL's Rotation; with the KiCad angle alone the model's pin 1 / polarity mark sat 90 or 180 degrees from the board's pad 1. shift: [dx, dy] in mm, in the footprint's own frame (x to the right, y down, as the footprint editor draws it), turned with the footprint, that make_outputs.py adds to the footprint's origin to get the CPL's Mid X/Y: the point where JLCPCB must put its model's origin for the model's body to cover the footprint's; with the origin alone the model sat dx, dy away from the footprint. A part not listed has neither (its model matched, or it is symmetrical: R, C, FB1, D5/D6; the LEDs D10-D13 matched: the viewer's + mark, the anode, sat on the board's pad 2 at the KiCad angle, and a +180 first tried for them put it on pad 1). The table is keyed by LCSC number, not by package: the model belongs to the part. check_outputs.py reads this file too; it fails an entry no BOM line uses, an entry with neither field, an add that is not a quarter turn, and a shift longer than its SHIFT_MAX. Each entry is confirmed only by the preview after the corrected CPL was uploaded (JLCPCB_REVIEW.md in the release candidate). Until 2026-11-13 this file was jlcpcb_model_rotation.json and held add only; Rev0.4's reviews and Rev0.5 r01's manifest name it so.

C2765186.seen: 2026-11-13, CPL point at the footprint's body centre: the model sat about 1.375 mm toward the mouth of that point, at the right orientation. The footprint's origin is its body centre and its mouth is toward +y; with the CPL point moved 1.375 mm away from the mouth (this shift) the viewer showed, on all four: front face 1.054 mm past the board edge (design 1.06), tails 6.325 mm (J1, J4) and 6.34 mm (J2, J3) from the edge against the pad row's centre at 6.285 mm, pegs 2.82 mm either side of the axis (design 2.89). About 0.04 mm of reading error
